channel.title: Tray.io incidents — Vendor Status Watch

item.title: Billing and Usage Temporarily Unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
Due to a degradation of application performance, the Billing and Usage page was temporarily unavailable for all regions between approximately 11:00 UTC and 19:00 UTC. Billing and usage has been restored to normal functionality.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to support@tray.ai. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

item.title: Degraded Application Performance - Salesforce Connector [resolved]
item.description:
On 6 June 2026, some customers experienced Salesforce authentication failures, causing workflow disruptions. This was due to a 30-day refresh token TTL introduced on 7 May 2026 to meet new Salesforce security requirements. Access tokens used continuously for over 30 days had their refresh tokens expire, rendering them unusable. The issue has been resolved. Affected customers were required to re-authenticate their Salesforce connection to restore functionality.
We are implementing a proactive background refresh process for Salesforce authentications to ensure tokens are refreshed before the 30-day expiry, regardless of access token usage. We apologize for any inconvenience this incident may have caused. If you have any questions or need additional details, please feel free to reach out to

item.title: Degraded Application Performance Creating Data Tables and Vector Tables [resolved]
item.description: There was a span of about 10 to 15 minutes where customers may have experienced slowness or failures when creating or importing Data Tables or Vector Tables in Tray. Our engineering team has identified the root cause, resolved the incident and have restored performance of the affected services. For any users who may have experienced this degradation in performance, you may have to retry creating or importing the affected Data Table or Vector Table. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to to support@tray.ai. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

item.title: Degraded Application Performance [resolved]
item.description:
From May 7, 2026 14:00 - 16:00 UTC, some customers may have experienced Salesforce authentication issues, including failures refreshing OAuth tokens and intermittent authentication errors when creating or re-authenticating Salesforce connections. This incident has now been resolved and all our systems are operational.
A small number of customers may still need to manually re-authenticate their Salesforce connections if workflows continue experiencing authentication failures.
We apologise for any inconvenience this incident may have caused. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to support@tray.ai.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

item.title: Degradation in Service Causing Webhook Requests to Timeout [resolved]
item.description:
There was a degradation in service that caused a small number of requests to Tray webhook workflow endpoints to timeout or return a 504 status. Workflows in the Tray platform will complete successfully even though responses to the client were never sent in a minority of cases.
Our engineering teams have identified the issue and resolved the root cause and we will continue to monitor performance of the webhook workflows and ensure their reliability.
If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to support@tray.ai
